title: Rabbi Acha bar Avin bar Binyamin
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah, chapter 8, on verse 6, reporting in the name of Rabbi Acha, son of Rav Pappi. Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, page 163a, reads “in the name of R’ Abba, son of R’ Pappi.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The cited source readings differ between Acha and Abba as the son of Rabbi Pappi.

Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6:2 fully writes Rabbi Acha son of Rav Pappi. The Mandelbaum digital Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 24:11 has R’ Abba son of R’ Pappi; its abbreviations are left unexpanded here. The earlier note’s Rabbi Pappi should therefore not be taken as a full-title reading shared by both sources. Hyman’s 163a reference is retained.
